column1: # tests/doom-core/fixtures/screens/DEMO1-rejected.tsv — a recording the PORT does not produce.
# THE INPUT THAT MAKES THE PORT-AGAINST-RECORDING CHECK FAIL. It is DEMO1.tsv
# with the VIEWHASH of ONE frame altered by a single hex digit -- gametic 42,
# early enough that a 60-tic run reaches it -- and nothing else. The port must
# report exactly one golden-disagree, at that frame. A fixture that drifted into
# differing everywhere would still be refused and would have stopped testing
# anything, so the shape of the failure is asserted and not only its presence.
# Taken by examples/doom/bin/sim_demo.rb with the unmodified library and
# the renderer in job mode 0: no port, no patched copy, no native library.
# Regenerate by re-deriving it from DEMO1.tsv, not by recording a run.
